title: Uv Metric3 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uv:metric3
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day uv metric3 (3) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on uv metric3 (3) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It rates what time of day your uv metric3 (3) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
